_comment: Example snapfix config for the bundled hello-static demo app. Copy to qa.config.json at your app root (the CLI writes it during `snapfix init`). JSON has no comments, so each section carries a `_comment`. Full docs: README.md > Configuration. This demo is a plain static page with no test suite, so loop.goal.tests.required is false.

board._comment: The two GitHub repos that back the board. `repo` is the PUBLIC repo (GitHub Pages + issue metadata, no images). `private` is the PRIVATE repo that holds screenshots only — never served, token-gated. `branch` is the branch both repos publish from (Pages source). Replace `owner` with your GitHub username; the CLI fills these in for you.

app._comment: The demo application. `repo` is the path to the app relative to this config file (`.` = the copy that lives at your app root, where the skill runs). `devServer` is the local URL the recapture script hits — `npx serve` / most static servers default to port 3000. `viewport` is WIDTHxHEIGHT in CSS px (390x844 = iPhone-sized). `framework` is a hint for the skill (here: a plain static page, no build).

reproduce._comment: How proof screenshots are recaptured after a fix. `tool` is the driver (playwright). `recaptureCmd` is run from the board repo; {route} is the issue's route and {out} the output image path. The default points at the bundled recapture.mjs.

auth._comment: How the recapture script reaches authenticated routes. The demo is fully public, so strategy is "none" — no login before screenshotting. `tokenKey` / `loginUrl` are unused at strategy "none" but kept for shape parity with the full config.

loop._comment: The fix-issues loop = trigger + goal (see LOOP.md). `trigger`: manual | schedule | action. `goal.satisfaction` is the LLM-as-judge bar (0-100) a fix must clear to post — the board's slider overrides it live via data/loop.json. `goal.tests` is the verifiable gate: this static demo has no test suite, so `required` is false (the loop skips the test gate and relies on the satisfaction judge alone).
